about: PreToolUse moments for .claude/hooks/skill-moment.mjs. When a Bash command matches `pattern`, the hook injects the named skill's [Cnn] questions (all, or only `classes`). The questions stay owned by the skill; this file only says when to ask them.

moments.name: declare-done
moments.lead: You are about to open a PR. Answer each question in the PR text before you run this, or mark it not applicable with the reason:

moments.name: release
moments.lead: You are about to build or publish a release. Answer these first:

moments.name: shared-checkout
moments.lead: This changes the whole checkout (its branch or its installed dependencies). If `git status` shows changes you did not make, another session may be using this folder: work in a worktree instead (git worktree add .local/wt/<name>). Join a `cd` to this command with `&&`, not `;`, so a failed cd cannot leave it running in the folder you started from.
